✏️ Alternatives to myCOI, TrustLayer and Jones for construction COI tracking (2026)

The main alternatives to myCOI, TrustLayer and Jones for construction COI tracking are Forsured, PINS Advantage, bcs, Billy and Certificial. Each one is best for a different job: project-level requirements with the broker in the fix, endorsement wording inside Procore, published per-vendor pricing, payment holds, or live policy data.

✅ The alternatives to myCOI, TrustLayer and Jones that fit construction COI tracking are Forsured, PINS Advantage, bcs, Billy and Certificial. None is best at everything, so this guide says what each one is best for.

✅ PINS Advantage and Forsured put a person on every decision. illumend, the platform myCOI customers are moving to, lets its AI decide on its own.

✏️ COI tracking software cost for construction in 2026: published prices compared

COI tracking software cost for construction runs from free, for up to 5, 25 or 50 vendors, to about $11 a vendor a year for self-service software and $10,000 a year minimums for managed tiers. Most published prices are per vendor. Forsured, Jones, illumend and TrustLayer's paid tiers quote on request.

✅ Published COI tracking software cost for construction runs from free tiers (Certificial up to 5 suppliers, bcs up to 25 vendors, TrustLayer up to 50) to about $11 a vendor a year for self-service and $10,000 annual minimums for managed tiers.

✅ Most COI tracking software pricing is per vendor or per certificate tracked, not per user. PINS Advantage, Certificial and TrustLayer's Complete plan include unlimited users.

● Buyer's guide · 6 min read

✏️ COI tracking software checklist: what a general contractor should look for (12 points)

A COI tracking software checklist for a general contractor starts with two questions: does it hold requirements by project, and does it read the endorsements, not just the certificate? The other ten points cover the broker fix, renewals, wrap-ups, who makes the call, integrations, security and price. Each one comes with a test.

✅ The first two points on any COI tracking software checklist are the ones that separate tools: requirements held by project, and endorsement review that reads the forms instead of the checkboxes.

✅ Test every point with your own documents. A certificate with the additional insured box checked and no endorsement attached is the fastest way to see what a tool really reads.

● Tech stack · 6 min read

⚙️ Procore COI tracking: where contractor insurance lives in Procore and what it checks

Procore COI tracking works through insurance records in the Directory, at company or project level, with policy numbers, limits, dates and the certificate attached. Procore Pay can turn those records into a compliance status that helps decide if an invoice is ready to pay. What Procore's docs don't describe is reading the endorsements.

✅ Procore COI tracking lives in the Directory: each insurance record holds the type, provider, policy number, limit, effective and expiration dates, a status and the certificate as an attachment, at company level or for one project.

✅ Procore Pay can use those records as a payment requirement, so a commitment shows Compliant or Not Compliant before an invoice is paid. Procore's docs describe entering insurance by hand and don't describe reading endorsements.
